richard (dickie) kieran; joseph markey; seamus walker the commemoration of all the faithful departed (all souls’ day): monday november 2nd - mass will be celebrated at 10am and 7.30pm in st. brigid’s church, dunleer. annual mass of remembrance: for our parish will be celebrated in st. brigid’s church, dunleer on friday november 27th at 7.30pm. plenary indulgences for the holy souls: from 12 noon on 1st november until midnight on 2nd november, a plenary indulgence may be gained by visiting a church, praying the our father and apostles’ creed, and fulfilling the usual conditions. from 1st –8th november, a plenary indulgence may also be gained by visiting a cemetery and praying for the dead. in both cases, the conditions include confession, holy communion and prayer for the pope’s intentions. blessing and celebration of the mural of st. brigid (side of centra): 12.30pm on sunday november 1st (all saints’ day) november: for the holy souls in purgatory, the rosary will be prayed in mosstown cemetery on saturdays in november at 3pm. the rosary will also be prayed in st. brigid’s church at 6.30pm each tuesday in november. parish collections : last weekend – parish € 1,505 ; dues € 230; mission sunday € 558. sincere thanks for your ongoing support. aid to the church in need (acn) is a catholic charity supporting persecuted and suffering christians around the world, providing pastoral, spiritual and practical assistance to communities facing poverty, oppression and religious persecution. through mass stipends, support for priests and religious, church construction and emergency aid, acn helps keep the faith alive where the church faces hardship. next weekend, mr. harry casey (acn) will speak at masses about their work. dromin church: painting of the interior has begun and it is hoped to be completed by christmas. while keeping the church open as much as possible for prayer, there may be days when it has to be closed. these days will be notified via our parish facebook page and a dedicated page on our website – our parish / dromin painting. pope leo’s prayer intention for nov: let us pray for the proper use of wealth, that not succumbing to the temptation of selfishness, it may always be put at the service the common good and solidarity of those who have less. parish list of the dead: lists & envelopes ought to be returned as soon as possible please. dunleer

and parishioners are welcome to view them. a sincere word of thanks for your ongoing support of our parish. first saturday devotions: will take place in our church on saturday 7th november, with a period of meditation from 9.45am – 10am, followed by the rosary (10am), mass (10.30am) and sacrament of reconciliation (11am). these will be undertaken with the intention of making reparation to the immaculate heart of mary, as requested by our lady during her apparitions at fatima, and also to promote vocations plenary indulgence (applicable only to the dead) can be gained (once only) by all who have confessed, received communion and prayed for the pope’s intentions (our father & hail mary or prayer of choice), by visiting a church between 12noon on 1st november and midnight on 2nd november, and reciting the our father and the creed. confession can be made at any time in the week before or after 1st november. the same indulgence can be gained once per day , from 1st to 8th november, by visiting a cemetery and praying for the dead. altar society: group dare responsible in november “prayer around the cross ” in candlelight with the music of taize 6th november in “bethany” 34 point road, a91woc 9 at 8pm to 9pm all welcome . followed by tea/coffee. tel.

november dead list: will be available at the doors of the church from this weekend. these should be returned via the box provided at the back of the church. please note it is not necessary to include a donation but, as some people choose to do so, parishioners are asked not to leave returned dead lists in the church outside of mass times. names for the november dead list can also be emailed to the parish office. mass will be celebrated on each first friday for all those on the list. the legion of mary needs you: the legion of mary is a catholic lay association. it’s object is the glory of god. fruits of membership: members share in the prayers and good works of active members throughout the world and gain indulgenes in the saying of the rosary. turn up any monday (except on bank holidays) at the parish conference centre, the mall, newry at 3pm vocations to the diocesan priesthood: anyone interested in joining a discernment group to consider aspects of the diocesan priesthood are invited to contact fr barry matthews, at
